mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (measured as month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS rises by at least 50k and UNRATE falls by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by GDP growth above 2% and housing starts above 2000k units), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening in consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where HOUST declines by at least 1% and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST > 2000).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market slack (unemployment rate above 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points and UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that reduces inflation without causing a recession, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.1 percentage points and CPIAUCSL yoy change declines by at least 0.2 percentage points.
